notes.subject: צפניה / צפן
notes.rationale: Go boela ga lentšu la go pata ka gatelelo — go pata ga moya ga go na tlhako ya go pata, se se bolokilweng ka go boela ga 'go pata'

notes.subject: יקרא
notes.rationale: Diphetholelo di fapana kudu: 'a a bitša' goba 'a tla tlogela' goba 'a thula kgahlanong le one' (ASV) — mafura a sa kgonego go swarwa ka seatla

notes.subject: letshwao la gagwe la go ja
notes.rationale: ימינו e ka balwa e le 'seatla sa gagwe sa go ja' goba e le seka sa maatla — 'go swara mafura ka seatla se sengwe' ke gore ga go kgonege go di swara

translation: Go e pata ke go pata ruakh, gomme mafura a letshwao la gagwe la go ja — a a bitša.

tokens.gloss: a letshwao la gagwe la go ja
